headline: Canucks place Ilya Safonov on waivers to terminate contract
take: Daily Faceoff reports the Canucks have put Ilya Safonov on waivers to terminate his contract, after four assists in 12 AHL games with Abbotsford. On its own it's a small roster move. In context it reads to us like a team tidying up a season that has gone wrong fast: the Canucks are 3-16-1, seven points from 20 games. They have about 40% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) and allow 3.74 an hour, and their goaltending has let in roughly 14.8 more goals than the shots deserved. Freeing a contract slot won't touch any of that, but it does give the organization room to look at someone else.
